stem: The author’s position about the Internet is that —

options.label: F
options.text: people should not rely solely on the Internet to provide them with news and other information

options.label: G
options.text: although the Internet is often useful, it can become addictive and hamper human interaction

options.label: H
options.text: people can have meaningful vacations only if they leave all electronic devices at home

options.label: J
options.text: even though there are some good things about the Internet, overall it has affected civilization for the worse
